China’s CZ-7A rocket, carrying the Zhongxing-4B communications satellite, exploded during first-stage flight approximately 85 seconds after liftoff from the Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site on Hainan Island.
The incident marks the 18th flight of the CZ-7A and only its second launch failure.

The intelligence operators used Magura unmanned surface vessels (USVs) configured as motherships to carry and launch FPV drones.
